advisories.title: CVE-2026-64849: MLflow webhook test endpoint SSRF
advisories.summary: MLflow before 3.15.0 validates only the initial webhook URL, then follows redirects without pinning the validated address. An unauthenticated attacker may reach internal or cloud metadata services. Upgrade to 3.15.0.

advisories.title: CVE-2026-27966: Langflow CSV Agent prompt injection to RCE
advisories.summary: Langflow before 1.8.0 hardcodes dangerous code execution for its CSV Agent, exposing LangChain's Python REPL to prompt injection and arbitrary server-side commands. Upgrade to 1.8.0.

advisories.title: CVE-2026-54745: Kubeflow Pipelines unauthenticated SSRF
advisories.summary: Kubeflow Pipelines before 2.17.0 allows unauthenticated proxy requests to attacker-selected HTTP/S targets, potentially exposing cloud metadata credentials and cluster-internal APIs. Upgrade to 2.17.0.

advisories.title: CVE-2026-44182: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway YAML injection
advisories.summary: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway before 3.3.0 interpolates untrusted kernel environment variables into Kubernetes manifests without YAML-aware escaping, enabling privileged resource creation. Upgrade to 3.3.0.

advisories.title: CVE-2026-44181: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway template injection
advisories.summary: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway 2.0.0rc2 through 3.2.x permits Jinja template expressions in kernel environment variables, enabling Python and OS command execution in the gateway service. Upgrade to 3.3.0.
